title: FunctionalFeaturesInput
description: Schema for functional residue feature coordinate mapping input (--features)

reference_id.description: Sequence identifier or accession substring of the reference sequence in the FASTA file

name.description: Human-readable name of the functional residue or motif site

position.description: 1-based unaligned residue coordinate on the reference sequence

type.description: Category such as active_site, binding_site, ptm_site, or motif
